notes: Ground truth only. 'reference_answer' is graded by an LLM judge (no keyword matching). 'expected_pages' lists every PDF page (1-based, as pypdf counts them) whose text states the fact, located by searching the PDF; it drives the retrieval hit@k/MRR and citation checks and is empty when the answer is not in the document. It holds only the three sample questions from the task spec.

questions.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
questions.reference_answer: GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries (in 25 states) in FY 2018.

questions.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
questions.reference_answer: govinfo replaced FDsys. Its full-scale deployment happened over FY 2018: it moved out of beta in December 2017, ran in parallel with FDsys through 2018, and FDsys was retired and completely replaced by govinfo in December 2018.

questions.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
questions.reference_answer: About $375.7 million (the report also says 'more than $375 million') of printing and other information products, across more than 84,000 orders.
